message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: Defendant (何某) signs a rental agreement with the actual car owner (郭某某) for a taxi, paying monthly rent. Then he lies to a victim (马某某), claiming he is the car owner, signs a rental agreement, collects rent and deposit for a year (total 50,600). Later the real owner retrieves the car from the victim. Victim asks for rent and deposit back, defendant refuses.

This is essentially fraud (诈骗) by misrepresenting ownership and collecting rent and deposit. Also possibly "合同诈骗" (contract fraud) because he used a contract to defraud. In examples, similar scenario: contract fraud is used when fraud is done via contract. Example earlier: "合同诈骗" used for similar case where someone pretended to be a company and signed contracts to get money. So the appropriate charge: 合同诈骗.

Check other possible crimes: Could be "非法占有" but that's part of fraud. Not theft because he didn't take property by force; he obtained money by deception. So fraud.

Thus answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>
